- 28,797 to 82,341 €: 30% (tax on portion between 28,797 and 82,341 at 30%)

Now compute tax on 59,266.6667 using brackets.

Second bracket: 11,294 to 28,797: amount = 28,797 - 11,294 = 17,503. Tax = 17,503 * 11% = 1,925.33.

Third bracket: 28,797 to 59,266.6667: amount = 59,266.6667 - 28,797 = 30,469.6667. Tax = 30,469.6667 * 30% = 9,140.90.

Total tax on quotient = 1,925.33 + 9,140.90 = 11,066.23 (approx). Actually we should sum: 1,925.33 + 9,140.90 = 11,066.23.

Now multiply by quotient 1.5: total tax = 11,066.23 * 1.5 = 16,599.345.

Rounded to nearest euro? The instruction: "Les montants sont en euros entiers." So we should round to integer. Usually tax rounding to nearest euro. So 16,599 €.

Bracket2: 11,294-28,797: amount 17,503 *11% = 1,925.33

But our income is 88,900 > 82,341, so we also have portion in next bracket: 82,341 to 88,900: amount = 88,900 - 82,341 = 6,559 *41% = 2,688.19.

Now sum: 1,925.33 + 16,063.2 + 2,688.19 = 20,676.72.
